<!-- Delete this section if your PR does not touch Packages/BackglanceCapture/**/Adapters/**,

- [ ] A fixture was added or updated under `Tests/Fixtures/SystemStore/`
- [ ] `expected.json` and `manifest.json` were updated alongside it

## Privacy Checklist

<!-- These are invariants, not preferences. See docs/security/SECURITY.md. -->

- [ ] No notification content (title, subtitle, body, sender, thread ID, deep link) reaches any `Logger` call, the file log, or the diagnostics export
- [ ] No real notification content, verification codes, phone numbers, or email addresses appear in tests, fixtures, or docs
- [ ] Apple's notification store is only opened read-only, from a copied snapshot
- [ ] Redaction still happens in memory, before anything is written to the archive
